evidence.claim: Recurring weekly charge: 2 earlier W charges of about $77.07 on the same account (holder 21139|444.0|73) at weekly intervals
The flagged transaction continues account 21139|444.0|73, which has 10 earlier transactions and no confirmed-fraud case
The same amount ($77.08, product W) was charged on account 21139|444.0|73 before, on 2016-11-26

Model risk score 0.61. For product W transactions without an identity record in this score band, 38% were confirmed fraud in July to October (3,436 transactions), so the score is read at that calibrated rate, not at face value

Policy applied, Fraud Policy 6. Stopping: Stop investigating when one of these holds:

- Fraud probability is at or above 0.85, or at or below 0.15, supported by at least two independent pieces of evidence
- A verification response settles the question
- Further steps are unlikely ...

case.summary: The alert was triggered when the real-time model scored transaction 3514030 at 0.61, a $77.07 in-person purchase on card C12382-K1 in billing region 444. The strongest findings are that this transaction is part of a recurring weekly charge pattern, with two earlier W-type charges of about $77.07 on the same account at weekly intervals, and the same amount ($77.08, product W) was previously charged on 2016-11-26, with ten earlier transactions on the account and no confirmed-fraud cases. The case was judged legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.06. The recommended actions are to allow the transaction and close the case with no fraud finding.
